name: MIR (NSPK payment system)
note: Operator of the Mir payment system, 100% owned by the Central Bank of the Russian Federation. Official KHL league partner for 2026-27 and a chest-patch sponsor on Torpedo Nizhny Novgorod's 2026-27 home jersey. The Central Bank said in September 2026 it may sell shares in NSPK while keeping at least 50% plus one share; a sale to market participants was reported to be planned for 2027 (Interfax, 2026-09-24).

why.text: The MIR card patch on Torpedo's shirt is paid for by NSPK, which is wholly owned by the Central Bank of Russia, the Russian Federation's central bank — a state that launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022 and has been at war with Ukraine since, with UN human rights monitors documenting rising civilian casualties.
why.messageLine: Ask Torpedo about the MIR patch paid for by Russia's state-owned card system
